tasks.gr8-visual-arts-t1: Topic: Visual Arts. Cover elements of art, observational drawing, line, shape, colour, texture, and balanced 2D composition. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify art elements in examples, choose suitable techniques for observation drawings, and explain composition decisions.
tasks.gr8-music-t1: Topic: Music. Cover beat, rhythm, metre, pitch, dynamics, notation basics, and listening skills. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify musical elements, read simple notation ideas, respond to rhythm and beat patterns, and choose accurate listening observations.
tasks.gr8-drama-t1: Topic: Drama. Cover warm-ups, voice projection, tableaux, improvisation, and character development. Ask Grade 8 learners to select suitable drama techniques, interpret freeze-frame ideas, and justify voice and body choices in short scenes.
tasks.gr8-dance-t1: Topic: Dance. Cover locomotor and non-locomotor movement, posture, space, time, counting, and safe stretching. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify movement types, apply timing cues, and choose safe technique practices during dance sequences.
tasks.gr8-ca-music-literacy-t1: Topic: Music literacy. Cover note values (semibreve, dotted minim, minim, crotchet, quaver) and rests, the time signatures 2/4, 3/4 and 4/4 (top number = beats in a bar), the treble and bass clefs and letter names on the lines and spaces, and the construction of the C major and G major scales with the pattern tone tone semitone tone tone tone semitone (G major has one sharp, F sharp). Ask Grade 8 learners to count beats in bars, fill a bar, name notes and identify the notes and sharps of the scales.
tasks.gr8-ca-instrument-families-t1: Topic: Families of instruments. Cover membranophones (stretched skin: djembe, ngoma drum, snare drum), idiophones (the body vibrates: marimba, triangle, shaker), chordophones (strings: guitar, violin, uhadi) and aerophones (a column of air: flute, recorder, vuvuzela) and how to describe how the sound is produced when listening. Ask Grade 8 learners to sort instruments into families and say what vibrates.
tasks.gr8-ca-lettering-graffiti-t1: Topic: Creative lettering and graffiti. Cover lettering in popular culture (posters, packaging, signs, murals, graffiti), the art elements shape, line, tone, texture and complementary colour (red-green, blue-orange, yellow-purple), the design principles contrast, proportion, emphasis, unity and balance, designing with coloured inks and small brushes at different paper sizes, respecting other people's opinions and making graffiti on paper or only with permission. Do not name real artists or artworks. Ask Grade 8 learners to identify elements and principles, complementary colours and respectful, legal practice.
tasks.gr8-ca-clay-containers-t1: Topic: Clay and mythological containers. Cover functional containers (function decides form), the pinch pot in earthenware clay (ball, thumb, pinch even walls, smooth, decorate), joining clay by scratching both surfaces and using slip, surface decoration, and a mythological container made from recyclable materials (fabric off-cuts, beads, cardboard, braids, ribbons, sequins) with preliminary sketches, depth and good craftsmanship. Ask Grade 8 learners to match function to form, order the steps and choose safe, correct craft methods.
